## NICS AI Trader

NICS AI Trader is a Telegram-first AI technical analysis and trading signals product with a secure Mini App, covering gold, forex and crypto markets.

Supported market groups:
- Gold
- Forex
- Brent Oil
- Bitcoin

Core product functions:
- AI technical analysis producing structured market scenarios with Entry, Stop Loss and TP1-TP4
- Compact Telegram signal delivery
- Accept or skip decisions
- Personal risk profile and exposure limits
- Active-signal status and lifecycle tracking
- Signal history and user-specific statistics
- Market selection and signal preferences

NICS AI Trader does not guarantee profit and does not replace professional financial advice. Trading involves substantial risk.

Product access:
- [Telegram bot](https://t.me/nics_ai_bot)
- [Public Telegram channel](https://t.me/TravelTradeBook)
- [Mini App](https://aibyteconsult.com/nics-app)

## NICS Video and NICS Studio

NICS Video edits a user's own raw clips automatically: from one upload it returns a vertical Short (9:16, about 30 seconds), a horizontal YouTube video (16:9) and covers in two languages (Russian and English). It does not generate footage; it selects and cuts what the user filmed.

Access is credit-based: 10 free credits once at sign-up, then Start (14.99 EUR / 60 credits), Creator (34.99 EUR / 250 credits) or Pro (69.99 EUR / 700 credits) for 30 days. One automatic package costs 10 credits.

NICS Studio is an in-browser editor (in development) for editing a video by hand: cut, captions, text, music, filters, transitions and MP4 export. Files stay on the user's device.

The home, NICS AI Trader, NICS Video and NICS Studio pages are available in 12 languages: en, de, fr, ar, zh, pl, tr, it, bg, ru, es, pt (for example https://aibyteconsult.com/ru/nics-video/).

Prices are shown directly in EUR or USD on the product page.

- AI Trader Single Market: 7-day or 30-day access
- AI Trader Multi-Market: 7-day or 30-day access
- AI Trader Full Coverage: 7-day or 30-day access

For current prices and plan details, use the canonical product page: [https://aibyteconsult.com/trading/#nics-trader-plans](https://aibyteconsult.com/trading/#nics-trader-plans)
